description: This file implements a WhatsApp API client class that manages WebRTC connections, handles webhook requests for call events, and interacts with WhatsApp's API to accept, terminate, and verify calls. It includes methods for connection management, webhook verification, SDP filtering, and event handling for call connect and terminate events.

classes.name: WhatsAppClient
classes.description: Client for managing WhatsApp WebRTC call connections, webhook verification, and call event handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WhatsApp API client with tokens, session, and optional ICE servers and secret.

methods.name: update_ice_servers
methods.description: Updates the list of ICE servers used for WebRTC connections.

methods.name: update_whatsapp_secret
methods.description: Updates the WhatsApp webhook secret for request validation.

methods.name: update_whatsapp_token
methods.description: Updates the WhatsApp API access token.

methods.name: update_whatsapp_phone_number_id
methods.description: Updates the WhatsApp phone number ID.

methods.name: terminate_all_calls
methods.description: Terminates all ongoing WhatsApp calls and disconnects WebRTC connections.

methods.name: handle_verify_webhook_request
methods.description: Verifies webhook request from WhatsApp using challenge and token.

methods.name: _validate_whatsapp_webhook_request
methods.description: Validates webhook request signature using HMAC SHA256.

methods.name: handle_webhook_request
methods.description: Processes incoming webhook requests for call connect and terminate events, optionally invoking callbacks.

methods.name: _filter_sdp_for_whatsapp
methods.description: Filters SDP to include only SHA-256 fingerprints for WhatsApp compatibility.

methods.name: _handle_connect_event
methods.description: Handles a connect event by establishing WebRTC connection, pre-accepting, and accepting the call via API.

methods.name: _handle_terminate_event
methods.description: Handles a terminate event by disconnecting WebRTC connection and cleaning up.
